known.title: Preserve Python starter compatibility in the shared web app

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - creating an app with `forge init --starter python` and building or testing it. `src/forge/init.py:147` copies this same web app into Python starters, but uses Python's separate shared package. `src/forge/templates/starter-python/libs/shared/src/index.ts:1` exports none of the new format helpers, so this import breaks the web build; the new `format.test.ts` imports unavailable helpers too. The same compatibility gap affects this page's new export link at line 199 and `apps/web/e2e/formats.spec.ts:30`: Python's projects router has no export endpoint and matches `/export` against the UUID parameter (`src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/app/projects/routes.py:54`). Supplying the helpers alone therefore leaves a broken download and browser test. Keep the shared frontend, its tests, and both starter implementations compatible together.
